how: Monty's Rowing School offers coastal rowing lessons and Dubai Creek sessions for beginners, based at a beach club on the Palm Jumeirah (listing from 2014, so current availability should be confirmed).

The Dubai Chamber Orchestra is a community ensemble of amateur and professional UAE residents, founded in 2002, which has publicly recruited musically inclined adults; no current open sign-up page was found.

Mirdif Milers, a free club open to all abilities, meets every Monday evening at the main gate of Mushrif Park and runs the park's paths; dedicated desert trail groups meet at Al Qudra, beyond the metro radius.
The Dubai Pipe Band, a volunteer band of about 13 pipers and drummers, performs in Dubai and lists a contact for enquiries; whether it teaches beginners was not confirmed.
